definitions.gloss: oily skin; a skin type that produces excess sebum
definitions.explanation: One of the standard skin type categories in Japanese cosmetics and dermatology. Describes skin that secretes a large amount of sebum, giving it a shiny appearance and making it prone to clogged pores and breakouts. Contrasts with {乾燥肌|かんそうはだ} ('dry skin') and {混合肌|こんごうはだ} ('combination skin').

examples.japanese: ⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{脂性肌|しせいはだ}だ。
{脂性肌|しせいはだ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}いた→向く：02304_muku⟧⟦{化粧水|けしょうすい}→化粧水：15802_keshousui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}っている→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: I'm using a toner designed for people with oily skin.

examples.japanese: {脂性肌|しせいはだ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{洗顔後|せんがんご}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{保湿|ほしつ}→保湿：11617_hoshitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{怠|おこた}らない→怠る：03936_okotaru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{美容|びよう}→美容：00014_biyou⟧⟦{雑誌|ざっし}→雑誌：00686_zasshi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{書|か}いてあった→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: A beauty magazine said that for people with oily skin, it's important not to neglect moisturizing after washing your face.

notes:
Compound of {脂性|しせい} ('oily; greasy disposition') and ⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧ ('skin'). One of the five standard skin types commonly cited in Japanese beauty and skincare contexts: {普通肌|ふつうはだ} (normal), ⟦{乾燥肌|かんそうはだ}→乾燥肌：16609_kansouhada⟧ (dry), {脂性肌|しせいはだ} (oily), ⟦{混合肌|こんごうはだ}→混合肌：23961_kongouhada⟧ (combination), ⟦{敏感肌|びんかんはだ}→敏感肌：19065_binkanhada⟧ (sensitive).

USAGE:
- Frequently appears in skincare product labels and reviews: {脂性肌|しせいはだ}⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧ ('for oily skin'), {脂性肌|しせいはだ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}く→向く：02304_muku⟧ ('suited to oily skin').
- Can describe a part of the body (especially the T-zone) or the whole face.
- Also read as あぶらしょうはだ in some dictionaries; the on-reading しせい⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧だ is the standard in cosmetics.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {脂性肌|しせいはだ}⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{化粧品|けしょうひん}→化粧品：05119_keshouhin⟧: cosmetics for oily skin
- {脂性肌|しせいはだ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}く→向く：02304_muku⟧: suited to oily skin
- {脂性肌|しせいはだ}⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧: oily skin care measures
- {脂性肌|しせいはだ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{悩|なや}み→悩み：06650_nayami⟧: concerns of those with oily skin

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{乾燥肌|かんそうはだ}→乾燥肌：16609_kansouhada⟧: dry skin — the opposite skin type.
- ⟦{混合肌|こんごうはだ}→混合肌：23961_kongouhada⟧: combination skin — oily in some areas (often the T-zone) and dry in others.
- {普通肌|ふつうはだ}: normal skin — balanced skin, neither oily nor dry.
- ⟦{敏感肌|びんかんはだ}→敏感肌：19065_binkanhada⟧: sensitive skin — skin that reacts easily to irritation.
- {オイリー肌|おいりーはだ}: oily skin (loanword-based variant) — common in fashion magazines and cosmetic marketing.
